heading: 📄 Create PDF — schedule
intro: Choose a child and period. The preview shows the full schedule — the PDF scales automatically to fit one A4 sheet in landscape.

pdfSave.title: Where is the PDF saved?
pdfSave.mobile: iPhone/iPad: After Create PDF, a share sheet opens — choose Save to Files and pick a folder (e.g. iCloud Drive).
pdfSave.desktop: Computer: The PDF goes to your Downloads folder (often bottom-left in the browser).

preview.heading: Preview
preview.hint: Scroll down if a day has many activities.

pdfHelp.title: How to save the PDF
pdfHelp.introShare: The share sheet is open. Choose Save to Files to save the PDF.
pdfHelp.introPreview: The PDF opened in the browser{{filename}}.
shareSteps: In the share sheet: scroll and tap Save to Files.
Pick a folder (e.g. iCloud Drive or On My iPhone).
Find the file later in the Files app.
previewSteps: The PDF opened in a new view — tap Share (↑) in the top right.
desktopSteps: Open the Downloads folder on your computer.
Look for a file starting with {{prefix}} and today's date.
